svg.text: ARTIFACTS · A · OUTDOOR PROPS
Lamp posts & lanterns, fountains, garden objects & veiled statues, sitouts & planters for the Birthday Castle world · round 1

Each item: our own blend of the reference pictures named under its title (U-ids), night look, 1.7 m figure for scale, size and a web build note. Rules: no eyes, faceless veiled figures, stars instead of crosses, no modern things.
rose stone
deep rose
plum roof
roof shade
gold
marble
cast iron
amber glow
pink glow
teal glow
violet
LAMP POSTS & LANTERNS
warm amber on the avenue and bridge, pink and teal in gardens and Glowwood
Twin-lantern cast-iron post
U343 base, arm, plaque · U403 tall heads · U352 night glow
4.6 m tall · arm 1.4 m · base 0.66 m · every 20 m on the Long Bridge
Octagonal panelled base with ogee cap and a
gold-traced sunk panel on every face; fluted post
with three gold collars and a lotus-fleur plaque;
cross arm with down-curled scrolls carries two
vase lanterns; star finials, no crosses.
Build: Blender mesh baked to a light model (~1.2k
tris), glass = emissive shader, one shared point
light per pair.
head ×1.9
diamond-leaded glass
Acanthus globe candelabra
U155 arms, globes, lattice base · U152 heads · U352 collars
5.3 m tall · spread 1.9 m · forecourt, ballroom terrace
Tapered square base pierced with pointed
arches over a gold lattice; vase knop on the
shaft; an acanthus collar sends out four
S-scroll arms with leaf sheaths to five opal
globes; gold lotus-bud finial instead of the
pineapple.
Build: Blender mesh baked (~2k tris) + leaf
normal map; globes = emissive opal shader
(pink-to-amber fresnel).
Crystal lantern
U129 crystal spikes · U354 pink crystals · U219 slim lamp
3.3 m · Glowwood paths, Lantern Cove, stair flanks
A faceted rose crystal held in a
gold claw of four curved prongs on
a slim marble shaft wound with a
gold ribbon; raw crystal cluster
at the foot.
Build: mesh (~600 tris); crystal =
refractive-look emissive shader
with facet normals; sparkle
particles.
Hexagonal lantern on scroll bracket
U176 hex lantern + curl · U343 arrow arm and spirals · U234 wall bracket
arm 1.05 m · lantern 0.8 m · fixed at 3.2 m on castle walls, gatehouse, lanes
Wall plate with curled ends; twisted arm
ending in a spear tip, braced by an
S-scroll above and a big spiral below
filled with small curls; the hex lantern
hangs on a ring and chain, diamond-leaded
glass, flared hood with a curl.
Build: bracket = alpha cutout card pair
(or thin mesh), lantern = mesh ~400 tris,
emissive glass.
Pier-top acorn lantern
U352 pier lanterns · U397 bollard glow
pier 1.1 m · lantern 0.75 m
Pink stucco pier with soft
rounded cap; iron plinth
carries an acorn of ribbed
opal glass under a fluted
cap and gold knob.
Build: mesh ~300 tris,
instanced on every stair
and walkway pier.
Hanging pierced & mosque lamps
U263 arcade globes · U180 pierced lanterns · U258, U260 glass lamps
0.5–0.8 m bodies · chains 1–2 m
Left: pierced brass globe throwing
star-shaped light dots. Middle: faceted
onion of teal and rose glass between brass
ribs. Right: enamelled glass mosque lamp
hung by three chains from a ring.
Build: mesh ~300 tris each; light-cookie
(gobo) texture on a spot for the dots;
hung in rows in arcades and the cloister.
Paper, lotus & float lanterns
U289 chochin · U317 lantern rows · U135 lotus · U07, U50 floats
chochin 0.55 m · lotus 0.45 m · box 0.3 m
Ribbed rose-paper chochin with gold caps and a
tassel; lotus float of three petal rings round
a candle; washi box float on a dark base.
Floats bob and drift; reflections stretch on
the water.
Build: chochin = lathe mesh ~200 tris + rib
normal map; floats = instanced props (GPU
instancing, 300+), emissive shader.
FOUNTAINS & WATER
rose stone and gold, water lit teal from below
Armillary sphere fountain (forecourt centrepiece)
U380 rings, sphere, chalice, ziggurat · U360 stepped gold platform
9.4 m high · pool 15 m across · ziggurat 8.6 m
Gold rings with teal enamel channels, arrow tips and fin spikes orbit a glowing
water sphere on a gold chalice ringed with teal crystals; three-tier ziggurat with
gold edge bands, incised spiral glyphs and crystal shards; a sun-slot glows in tier
two; jets in a round stepped pool.
Build: rings = Blender mesh (separate objects, slow rotation in JS); sphere = water
shader with scrolling swirl normal + fresnel; plinth baked to a light model; jets =
particles. ~6k tris total.
plan
Water-curtain fountain
U344 curtain column, rosette frieze, coping, flag apron · U89 glowing sheet
6.4 m high · basin 8.4 m across · market square, circular walkway plaza
A round sheet of water falls all round a drum from a gold-rimmed
cap, lit teal from below; a veiled lamp-bearer stands on top. Big
round basin: frieze of square rosette panels, heavy rounded coping,
moulded plinth, radial flagstone apron.
Build: basin baked mesh ~3k tris + rosette normal map; curtain =
open cylinder with scrolling alpha water shader; mist particles.
Tiered fountain with planter
U284 cusped bowls, octagon, onion · U339 lobed rims · U346 tiers · U388 planter cups
4.3 m · pool 5 m · courtyards, Grand Balcony garden
Octagonal pool; a rose planter cup rings the shaft;
two cusped bowls drip a curtain from every scallop;
diamond-faceted onion finial with a lotus-bud jet.
Pink stone, gold lips.
Build: lathe meshes baked ~2.5k tris; drips = alpha
strips with scrolling shader; roses = instanced
cards.
Wall fountain
U345 niche + bowl · U177 spout into pool · U292 scallop basin
2.8 m high · 1.6 m wide
Pointed niche with gold cusped trim
and a star-tile back; an urn on a
console pours (no mask) into a
scallop basin, which spills into a
trough.
Build: mesh ~1.2k tris; tile =
decal; water = alpha strips.
Chadar cascade & lotus spout
U396 central cascade stair · world-layout grand-stair channel · U292 lotus
channel 3 m wide · slab 30° · one per landing (18)
Front: a lotus-bud spout on each landing feeds a cusped
weir; water slides down a slab carved in chevrons so the
sheet sparkles, over little lamp niches (chini khana),
into a lobed pool. Right: section of one 15 m flight.
Build: slab = mesh with chevron normal map; water = thin
sheet mesh, flow-map shader; niche lamps = emissive
cards.
section: weir, 30° chevron slab,
jet on each landing
GARDEN OBJECTS & STATUES
clock, armillary, sundial, wishing well, signs; every figure veiled and faceless
Clock post
U343 bracket clock + finial · U346 crested housing · U331
3.9 m · plaza, avenue, Storybook square
Panelled base, gold collars,
a two-faced clock in a
crested drum with scroll
brackets and a star; hands
stop at one minute to
midnight.
Build: mesh ~900 tris; face =
decal; hands animated (real
local time).
Armillary sphere
U80, U248 brass rings · U305 orb on plinth · U173 ring monument
2.5 m · observatory, Baroque gardens, plaza
Pink marble baluster; three gold
scroll feet hold meridian, horizon,
equator and a wide star-ticked
ecliptic band round a glowing orb;
tilted axis with star tips.
Build: rings = separate meshes, slow
turn; orb = emissive; ~1.5k tris.
Sundial
U157 dial plate on carved pedestal
1.15 m · Baroque terraced gardens
Twisted pink baluster on a
square step; bronze dial with
star rose and hour marks;
scroll-cut gold gnomon. Plan
view above.
Build: mesh ~500 tris + dial
decal; moon-dial shadow shader
at night.
dial plan
Wishing well
U189 octagonal well-head with blind arches & volutes · U392 wellhouse arch · U129 iron arch canopy
3.3 m with canopy · well-head 2 m across · courtyard, village square
Two-step octagonal base; carved well-head with a
blind arch on each face and a volute at every
corner; whiplash iron canopy with a pulley, rope
and bucket, a hanging star lantern; teal glow and
rising sparkles from the water.
Build: stone baked mesh ~1.5k tris; canopy alpha
card or thin mesh; sparkle particles on a coin
toss.
Signpost & sign bracket
U346 finger signpost · U343 arrow-arm bracket, scalloped plaque · U349, U224
post 3.0 m · boards 0.8 m · bracket arm 0.9 m
Finger post with three gold-edged boards naming the
zones and a small lantern on top. Wall bracket:
spear-tipped arm, C-scrolls and spirals, a hanging
plaque with an ogee-scalloped top (cake emblem for the
party salon).
Build: post mesh ~500 tris, board text = decal;
bracket = alpha card, plaque mesh swings gently.
Veiled statues (faceless)
U139 column statues · U350 urn bearer · U132, U379 winged guardian · U14, U401 veils
column statue 7.8 m · urn bearer 3 m · guardian 3.4 m
Column statue: slender shaft with gold rings and leaf capital, veiled figure with gilt
hood edge (avenue rows). Urn bearer on a panelled pedestal. Winged guardian on a stepped
plinth with gold feather wings and a star halo. Every hood is an empty soft-shadowed oval,
no face.
Build: one sculpted veiled body baked to ~2k tris + normal map, reused with three props;
column = instanced.
SITOUTS & PLANTERS
benches, café set, urns and topiary for walkways, terraces and courtyards
Curved scroll-back stone bench
U128 pierced scroll back · U85 carved stone bench · U14
2.6 m long · seat 0.45 m · back 0.95 m
Seat follows the walkway curve; the back
is pierced with S-scroll cut-outs between
gold-lined rails; volute ends and
scroll-foot supports. White marble.
Build: mesh ~1.4k tris; piercing via
alpha-tested normal map on the back slab.
Wrought-iron scroll bench
U155 scroll ends + slats · U154 park bench · U351
1.8 m long · 0.85 m high
Rose-wood slats on cast-iron ends; the end
frame (right, side view) is a lyre of
C-scrolls with a curled arm and scroll
feet.
Build: slats mesh + end frame alpha card
(two instances); ~400 tris.
Trellis-back bench with cushion
U284 gold trellis, scalloped crest, red cushion · U388 lotus crests
1.9 m long · 1.05 m high
Rose-gold frame, a gold ogee-lattice
back under a scalloped crest rail with a
lotus crest, plum velvet cushion with
gold piping, turned legs, scrolled arms.
Build: mesh ~900 tris; lattice = alpha
cutout; cushion = soft baked normal.
Sitout table, lace chairs & parasol
U262 lace chairs, marble table · U230, U313 café sets · U389 scalloped parasol · U341 hurricane
table 0.8 m Ø · parasol 2.6 m Ø, 2.5 m high
Round marble top on a cast-iron pedestal with three scroll
feet; two lace-back chairs (oval pierced backs, cabriole
legs, rose cushions); rose-and-cream parasol with scalloped
valance and star finial; hurricane candle on the table.
Build: set = one baked mesh ~2.5k tris; lace = alpha cutout;
candle flicker shader. A set every 14 m on the circular
walkways.
Planters, urns & topiary pots
U350 urn · U343 goblet bowl · U388 planter cups · U154, U403, U310 topiary
urn 1.7 m · goblet 0.9 m · planter column 2.3 m · topiaries 1.2–2.2 m
Gadrooned urn with scroll handles on a panelled pedestal; white goblet bowl; column with teal-collared planter
cups; spiral cone in a Versailles box with gold ball finials; ball topiary in a gold-banded pot; three-ball
topiary strung with fairy lights.
Build: pots = lathe meshes ~300 tris, instanced; topiary = clipped leaf-card spheres with a leaf normal map;
lights = instanced emissive dots.
